label: CONNECTION

points.heading: Send a mid-day text
points.body: Not about chores or schedules. Just a little warmth in the middle of the day.

points.heading: Hold eye contact a moment longer
points.body: It feels small, and it says a lot.
points.panel: Next time he talks to you, put your phone down and look up.

points.heading: Remember an early moment
points.body: Bringing up your early days can bring back that feeling.
points.panel: “Remember our first date? You were so nervous.”

points.heading: Compliment something new
points.body: Go past “you look nice.” Name something specific.
points.panel: “That shirt makes your eyes look really blue.”

points.heading: Make a small plan just for two
points.body: Something to look forward to together.
points.panel: “Saturday night, it’s just us. I’ll plan it.”

close.save: Save this and try one tonight.

caption:
Flirting isn’t only for new couples. In a long marriage, it’s one of the easiest ways to remind each other that you still choose this.

None of these takes more than a minute. Try one tonight and see what happens. The point isn’t to be smooth. It’s to let him know you still notice him.

Share this with a friend who could use a little fun, and follow @spotseason for more.
